title: 第10章 一年
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
林玄没有立刻接过，而是看了一眼方才陈素仪离开的方向，开口问道。

    “方才那位陈小姐买的聚灵散，贵阁可还有存货？”

    “可否介绍一二？”

    侍女微微一怔。

    她上下看了林玄一眼，神色中明显多了几分意外。

    “仙师可是想买聚灵散？”

    “不错。”

    侍女迟疑片刻，很快解释道。

    “聚灵散与养元丹一样，也是一阶下品丹药，不过药效要比养元丹强上不少。”

    “养元丹胜在性价比高，药性温和，适合炼气初期修士日常服用。”

    “但一枚养元丹的药力，大约只能抵五日苦修，而且七日方能服用一枚。”

    “而一瓶聚灵散，则可抵七日修炼，且四日便可服用一瓶。”

    “若论对修炼速度的提升，自然要比养元丹好得多。”

    说到这里，侍女语气微顿，有些迟疑地看向林玄。

    “只是聚灵散价格也较贵一些。”

    “一瓶要三块灵石......”

    林玄在心中暗啧了一声。

    “被人看不起了......”

    不过，一瓶三块灵石，确实不便宜。

    要知道，寻常炼气初期修士，一个月所得也不过五到十块灵石。

    扣去日常开销之后，能攒下三五块灵石便已经算是不错。

    而这一瓶聚灵散，几乎就能抵得上普通炼气初期修士半个月的收入。

    不过，对于林玄来说，灵石不是问题。

    他只沉吟了一息，便下定了决心，道。

    “养元丹先不要了，给我取十瓶聚灵散。”

    侍女这一次是真的愣住了。

    不只是她，旁边几名还在低声议论的散修，也忍不住朝林玄看了一眼。

    侍女很快回过神来，连忙应声。

    “仙师稍候。”

    不多时，侍女便取出十只白玉小瓶，摆放在林玄面前的柜台上。

    林玄打开其中一瓶看了一眼。

    瓶中药散呈淡白色，细若霜粉，隐隐散发出一缕清凉药香。

    只吸入少许，体内灵力便似乎活跃了几分。

    林玄盖上瓶塞，微不可察地点了点头。
content_en:
Lin Xuan did not take it immediately, but glanced at the direction Chen Suyi left just now and asked.

    "Miss Chen bought the Juling Powder just now. Do you still have it in stock?"

    "Can you introduce me to something?"

    The maid was slightly startled.

    She glanced at Lin Xuan up and down, her expression obviously a little surprised.

    "Master Immortal, do you want to buy Spirit Gathering Powder?"

    "Not bad."

    The maid hesitated for a moment and quickly explained.

    "Juling Powder, like the Yangyuan Pill, is also a first-class low-grade elixir, but its efficacy is much stronger than the Yangyuan Pill."

    "Yuanyuan Dan is cost-effective and has mild medicinal properties. It is suitable for daily use by monks in the early stage of Qi refining."

    "But the medicinal power of one Yuan Yang Pill is only equivalent to five days of hard training, and you can only take one pill every seven days."

    "A bottle of Juling Powder can last for seven days of practice, and one bottle can be taken in four days."

    "In terms of improving the speed of cultivation, it is naturally much better than Yang Yuan Dan."

    Having said this, the maid paused slightly and looked at Lin Xuan hesitantly.

    "It's just that Juling Powder is more expensive."

    "One bottle costs three spiritual stones..."

    Lin Xuan secretly clicked his tongue in his heart.

    "Being looked down upon..."

    However, three spirit stones in a bottle are indeed not cheap.

    You know, an ordinary monk in the early stage of Qi refining can only earn five to ten spiritual stones in a month.

    After deducting daily expenses, it is considered good to be able to save three to five spirit stones.

    And this bottle of Gathering Powder is almost equal to half a month's income of an ordinary monk in the early stages of Qi refining.

    However, for Lin Xuan, spiritual stones are not a problem.

    He only pondered for a breath, then made up his mind and said.

    "I don't want the Yangyuan Pill now. Get me ten bottles of Gathering Powder."

    The maid was really stunned this time.

    Not only her, but several casual cultivators nearby who were still discussing in low voices couldn't help but glance at Lin Xuan.

    The maid quickly came to her senses and responded quickly.

    "Master Immortal, wait a moment."

    Not long after, the maid took out ten white jade vials and placed them on the counter in front of Lin Xuan.

    Lin Xuan opened one of the bottles and took a look.

    The Chinese medicine powder in the bottle is pale white, as fine as frost powder, and faintly exudes a refreshing medicinal fragrance.

    After just inhaling a little bit, the spiritual energy in the body seemed to be a little more active.

    Lin Xuan capped the bottle and nodded imperceptibly.
